s02.note: t=0: the rod is lying on the board, untouched, and the locate fit agrees with the tracker to 0.4 mm. t=1.56–6.24 (k01–k04): the fingers come down beside the rod centre (candidate end0 s=0.020), close to a width of 3.4 mm and lift 7 cm. In k04 (t=6.24) the rod is clearly between the fingers and off the board in both views. It is held shallowly, near the fingertips: the rod centre is 6.8 mm deep in the TCP frame, and the plan says ~8 mm means 'at the tips'. Insert then runs the lift and a 144° rotation chain (psi 60) inside the first move_to_joints, with no keyframe between t=6.24 and t=13.84. The sheet still shows the rod in the fingers at t=8.0. By sheet t=10.0/13.3 and k05 (t=13.84) the rod is lying on the board again, near where it started, and the gripper width is -0.0002, so the fingers are closed on nothing. The rod slipped out of the shallow tip grip while the hand was being re-oriented. Insert then makes 10+2 move_to_joints near the fixture with an empty hand (t=13.84–24.36; one FAIL at 22.00 with err 22 mm, in open space with no wrench) and reports FAIL at 24.56 with 'rod not seen in hand'. That reason is correct. Nothing happens from then until the 40 s timeout. final.png: the rod is on the board and the empty hand is beside the blue fixture. Note: the tracker's part estimate in the trace is frozen at [0.6042, 0.0627, 0.0131] for the whole episode and cannot be used.

locate.evidence: Rod lying on the board, untouched, at t=0. Fit: ctr [0.580, 0.059, 0.013], ext 49.1 mm, rms 0.14 mm, n=3577, 0.4 mm from the tracker. Matches the global view.

grasp.evidence: k04 t=6.24: the rod is between the fingers, lifted about 7 cm off the board, and moved with the hand. Weakness: only 6.8 mm deep in the TCP frame (fingertip grip) with 22 mm of the rod visible. This shallow grip is what lets go during insert.

insert.evidence: The rod dropped out of the fingers during the lift/144° rotation between t=8 (sheet: still held) and t≈10–13.8 (sheet t=10/13.3, k05: rod back on the board, gripper fully closed at -0.0002). Every later move_to_joints was done with an empty hand. The policy's FAIL at t=24.56 ('rod not in hand') is correct. final.png: the rod is on the board, not in the bore.

s03.note: t=0: the rod is lying right next to the blue fixture. Locate: ctr [0.354, 0.042], rms 0.23 mm, 0.5 mm from the tracker. Grasp: every candidate was blocked by the nearby fixture (finger_pts > 1000). The policy pushed the rod sideways to [0.363, 0.018] (sheet t=2.7–8.0, the rod moved away from the fixture). Attempt 0 at t≈8.3–14.7: the fingers closed at contact height. In the 4 mm-up check the rod was not in the pads (TCP frame [-4.8, -3.4, -8.5] mm), so the policy reopened. Attempt 1 at t=15.0–20.4: closed 2.5 mm higher (width 4.5 mm) and lifted. In k08 (t=20.40) the rod is in the fingers, off the board, in both views. It is held about 9.6 mm off centre and 8.4 mm deep (at the tips). Insert: the plan's top candidates all fail (chain unreachable). It picked psi -15 (cost 112.9, 2976 hand-hit points) with a 168° rotation. k09 t=29.76: the hand is lifted to z≈0.16 above and beside the fixture, and the rod still hangs tilted from the fingertips. k10–k20 (t=30.6–39.4): eleven slow move_to_joints steps re-orient the hand almost in place (TCP stays near [0.356, 0.077, 0.162]). The rod stays in the hand at a changing tilt (k14 t=34.16: rod tilted, wrist camera view rolled). The last call ends FAIL with err 0.15 at t=39.44. The episode times out at 40 s in the middle of this rotation chain. final.png: the arm is contorted, the wrist camera points up at the arm's own links, and the rod is still in the fingers well above the fixture. There is no contact with the fixture (wrench < 2 N). The approach, alignment and descent never happened. The time budget ran out: 20 s spent on the push plus two grasp attempts, about 9 s on lift/planning and about 10 s on the slow rotation chain.

locate.evidence: Rod lying on the board next to the fixture at t=0. Fit: ext 48.9 mm, rms 0.23 mm, n=2409, 0.5 mm from the tracker. Matches the global view.

grasp.evidence: k08 t=20.40: the rod is between the fingers and lifted, and it moved with the hand from then to final.png. Caveats: it took a push and two attempts (attempt 0 slipped, not in the pads), and the final grip is 9.6 mm off centre and only 8.4 mm deep (at the fingertips).

insert.evidence: It never got past the rotation chain. k09–k20 (t=29.8–39.4): the hand re-orients in the air at z≈0.16 with the rod still held and tilted. The last move_to_joints FAILs (err 0.15) and the 40 s timeout hits before the pre-pose, alignment or descent. final.png: the rod is still in the fingers, far above the bore and not vertical. There was no collision; it ran out of time. The insert stage never reported a verdict.
